## Relationships

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas.md)

Thomas is married to [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), serving as her husband. While [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) frequently engages in local gossip and visits neighbors like [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to investigate their personal affairs, Thomas remains a background figure in her active social life.
